description: Give a live connection a persona name, so tools accept extension_id: '<name>'. Use it for connections pwa-debug did not launch with a profileName — an Android phone tab from pdl_android_attach (cdp:… id), a page attached with pdl_cdp_attach, or your existing browser profile — e.g. alice in a desktop Brave profile and bob on a real phone. Args: name (1-32 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]), connection_id? (from host_status activeConnections; omit when exactly one connection is live), remove? (drop the name). Names of named launches cannot be reused. Names of extension connections (stable ids) survive a host restart but expire after 24h without the connection being seen, so new test runs start clean; names of CDP connections (phone tabs, attached pages) last for this host session only, and a re-attached CDP page gets a new id, so name it again.

connection_id.description: The connection to name: an id from host_status activeConnections (cdp:… for a phone, extId#instanceId for a browser profile). Omit when exactly one connection is live.

name.description: Persona name to give the connection, e.g. 'bob'. Then pass extension_id: 'bob' to any tool.

remove.description: Drop the name instead of setting it.

name: pdl_name_connection
